key_impacts: Plant was damaged and Units 1–4 entered long-term decommissioning.
Large volumes of contaminated water generated; over 1,100,000 m3 of treated water stored on-site by Oct 2018.
evidence_snippets: Following the accident at TEPCO’s Fukushima Daiichi Nuclear Power Station on 11 March 2011.
addressing the situation of the damaged plants of Fukushima Daiichi.
As of October 2018, about 1,100,000 m3 of treated water is stored on-site.
missing_information: Casualty figures and release magnitudes not stated.
